title: Soft-Body Puppet Theater: Elastic Animal Companions
description: A rigged humanoid figure stands on a stage holding elastic soft-body tethers connected to a Fox and a Parrot. The user manipulates the figure's pose and tugs the tethers to deform the animals with jelly-like soft-body physics, adjusting stiffness, damping, and gravity to choreograph a bouncy puppet show.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (importmap with three and three/addons from cdn.jsdelivr.net). Load Fox.glb, Parrot.glb, and RiggedFigure.glb via GLTFLoader. Place the RiggedFigure at center on a flat stage plane. Position the Fox to the left and the Parrot flying to the upper-right, both connected to the figure's hands by visible elastic tether lines (use BufferGeometry lines updated each frame). Implement a vertex-level soft-body simulation on the Fox and Parrot meshes: on load, store rest positions for every vertex, then each frame apply spring forces pulling vertices toward rest shape, plus gravity, plus damping. When tethers are pulled, propagate displacement through the mesh so the animals stretch and wobble like jelly. Camera: PerspectiveCamera at (0,3,8) looking at origin, with OrbitControls. Lighting: warm DirectionalLight from upper-left, soft AmbientLight, and a colored SpotLight on the stage floor. User interactions (8 steps with validation): 1) Click-drag the RiggedFigure's right arm to pull the Fox tether — validate arm rotation between -90 and 90 degrees. 2) Click-drag the left arm to pull the Parrot tether — same validation. 3) A slider controls soft-body stiffness (0.01–1.0) affecting spring constant. 4) A slider controls damping coefficient (0.01–0.99). 5) A slider adjusts gravity strength (0–20). 6) A button triggers a 'bounce' impulse that displaces all soft-body vertices downward then lets them recover. 7) A color picker changes the tether color dynamically. 8) A 'Reset Pose' button snaps the figure arms and animal meshes back to rest state — validate all vertices return within epsilon of original positions. Display an HTML overlay panel for controls. Animate the Parrot's wing bones gently. Play Fox walk animation at reduced speed. Render soft-body deformation every frame using requestAnimationFrame. Add subtle shadow mapping on the stage.
